assets.title: 전체 컨셉
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone premium game asset concept image, a single three-quarter overall view of a small recessed floor guidance light for Stage1 Astra. The supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image 1 is an actual existing FBX observatory shown in its game scene; image 2 its FBM basecolor texture atlas, NOT a shape to copy. Match its clean friendly alien research facility aesthetic, pearl ceramic white, muted lavender, dark titanium and controlled ion cyan glow.
Design a compact LOW PROFILE elongated rounded chamfered rectangular floor light, nominal width X 350mm, depth Z 120mm, height Y 35mm. Long axis X. A simple pearl-white beveled perimeter shell, dark titanium thin bottom gasket/plinth, lavender end caps at the two short ends, ONE uninterrupted rounded rectangular cyan frosted glass emitter inset into the TOP, occupying most of its length. Four tiny recessed mounting screws, one in each corner. The front long face (-Z) has one centered small lavender trapezoidal inset with two short recessed slots. Back long face (+Z) has a centered flush service hatch and no exposed cable. Left and right end faces are symmetrically identical plain lavender inset panels. No upright post, no bollard, no antennas, no screens, no complex fins, no excess greebles.
Show one object isolated and fully visible, large centered front-right-top three-quarter view on a clean very pale lavender studio background with subtle contact shadow. Stylized high-quality PBR game prop concept, broad readable forms, refined edge bevels, satin ceramic and brushed titanium, minimal wear. Controlled glow, cyan glass stays visibly cyan, no blown-out white bloom. Keep low profile, like a small road stud or floor light cassette, NOT a tall device. Single image, single view, NO collage, no insets, no text, no labels, no watermark, no environment. Landscape image.

assets.title: 방향 화살표 모듈
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone single asset concept image for a companion to the attached canonical Stage1 Astra floor light. Image is a DESIGN FAMILY REFERENCE. Same friendly clean alien research outpost style; pearl-white satin ceramic chamfered shell, muted lavender inserts/endcaps, thin dark titanium lower gasket, restrained cyan frosted-glass illumination, four recessed mounting fasteners where suitable. Broad low-poly-friendly forms with refined bevels. Pale lavender studio background and soft contact shadow. One centered fully visible object, 3/4 front-right-top view, no collage, no panels, no inset, no text, no logos. Not a photoreal military gadget. Keep modestly detailed, no greeble clutter.
ASSET: A low-profile square DIRECTIONAL FLOOR TILE, approx 220mm square and 25mm high, matching the light family. Pearl-white chamfered square frame with four corner screws; inset lavender central plate carrying TWO parallel bright cyan chevrons pointing the same direction toward the FAR edge of the tile. Chevrons are luminous geometric inset glass, not printed text. Dark bottom gasket, tiny lavender side inserts. Single tile, isolated, no surrounding floor. Useful at turns and junctions.
